text:
nina (people-ops): FYI new hire Javier Morales starts Tue 2026-06-01. He's hybrid (SF office Tues/Thurs). Recruiter says passport + card from his home country; he's a US permanent resident with Form I-551. Need to confirm I-9 docs, background vendor is Sterling, and day-1 schedule.

sam (hr): Welcome Javier! For I-9, Form I-551 is List A so that's sufficient. He should present the original card for in-person verification on his first in-office day. For remote verification before first office day, we can use an approved notary or our third-party remote verifier (we prefer in-person for hybrid).

leo (onboarding-ops): Quick status:
- Sterling: background initiated, screening type: standard (SSN + criminal + address). Sterling invite sent, candidate hasn't accepted yet.
- Rippling: W-4 + state tax forms pending.
- Benefits: enrollment opens Day 1; he selected medical + commuter.
- Day 1 (06/01) tentative: 9:00 HR welcome, 10:00 security training, 11:00 team intro, 1:00 IT provisioning + badge pickup, 3:00 manager 1:1.
Link: https://onboarding.redwood.com/javier-morales (internal)

carlos-it: Laptop shipping to SF office for pickup. I'll reserve a desk on Tues and schedule badge appointment at 13:00. If Sterling clears after Day 1, we'll still give laptop but hold production access until background completes.

nina (people-ops): Sam, can we reimburse notary fees if he chooses remote verification before first office day?

sam (hr): Yes, up to $30 with receipt. Add that to the welcome email. Also note: if Sterling flags identity mismatch because his docs have diacritics or a different transliteration, ask him to provide his passport scan and any previous names. Sterling usually resolves via DOB + SSN match.

sterling-bot: background-check status: INVITE_SENT -> AWAITING_CANDIDATE (Sterling).

leo (onboarding-ops): Added a note to Javier's calendar invite: bring original Form I-551 or passport + I-94 if travel docs appear. Also asked him to complete Sterling consent and Rippling tax forms before start.

carlos-it: One small config note: SF office badge requires photo ID at pickup. We'll accept the Form I-551. I'll send the desk reservation and Zoom link for remote provisioning at 09:30 in case he starts remotely.

nina (people-ops): Thanks. I'll update the welcome packet to include acceptable docs, notary reimbursement, and Sterling privacy link. if anyone sees no candidate response by EOD Fri, pls ping here and I'll call the recruiter. Leaving open for follow-ups. :raised_hands:
